title: 第24章 放出向导素把米娅整不会了

第24章 放出向导素把米娅整不会了-《同时被N个S级哨兵盯上怎么办》

被追问了，米娅略微低头思考了一会儿，“这件事没有任何可疑之处，萧岑是在能完全自主的情形下，为从畸变体手中救回判断失误的队长，自行选择牺牲的。”

“哎哟……”秦夙纠结的哼唧了一声，“值得吗？还有什么比自己的命更重要的吗？”

“或许是，忠诚，勇气，和信念。”米娅说，“她是一位伟大的向导，值得所有人去尊敬与缅怀。”

秦夙吐槽，“还好你没说值得所有人去学习。”

米娅顿了顿，“白塔从不提倡非必要的牺牲。”

“非必要？”秦夙一下就抓住重点了，“这个非必要，在萧岑牺牲的事情上，是怎么个说法呢？”

米娅浅亚麻色的眸子转过来看了看秦夙，“你在套我的话。”

“我就是想套你的话，你多跟我说一点吧，我真被他们搞的头秃了。”萧岑对米娅双手合十，“求求了求求了~”

又是一种，哨兵和向导很少见的可爱行为。

米娅无奈的笑着摇摇头，“好，那我就把能说的部分，再说一些给你听。”

非必要牺牲，说的是尤来亚在污染区里有些孤勇和激进的冲动作战特征。

以及萧岑作为向导，虽然只是C级，但考虑向导，尤其是治愈型向导的稀有性，将她未来的潜力都算在内，她的价值并不比A+的尤来亚低。

萧岑应当首先保全自己才对。

“你说话好官方啊，我抗议！”秦夙皱着眉头一脸嫌弃。

米娅依旧笑着，似乎能够理解和包容一切不理解的声音，“你如果遇到类似的情况，请一定要优先保护好自己，答应我，好吗？”

这句倒是不官方了。

秦夙再哼唧一下，“我可怕死的很，也没那么高的为别人而牺牲的觉悟，再说我现在啥都不懂，一时半会儿的也够不上去污染区出任务的资格吧？”

米娅并不否认，“这些，离颂队长都会为你考虑到的，他没有下达随队作战的命令，你就无需跟他们一起。”

“那，那那那！”秦夙还想再挣扎一下，“你真的不能再跟我多说一点了吗？”

“可以啊~如果方便的话，可以允许我查看一下你的向导素吗？”

这算啥？纯纯打岔嘛！

秦夙就知道，米娅不可能再告诉她更多了。

苦着脸两手一摊，“我不知道怎么放向导素。”

“嗯？”米娅有些吃惊，“我以为魏老师已经教过你。”

“他……”秦夙脸一下就热起来了，“他就知道戳我后腰，对着我一顿狂吸，我现在只知道外力刺激腺体，是能放向导素的，但我难道每次放的时候，都自捶老腰吗？你也是向导，能不能教我点更体面的方法？”

Chapter 24: Release the guide Su to prevent Mia from being harmed - "What to do if you are targeted by N S-class sentries at the same time"

After being pressed, Mia lowered her head and thought for a while, "There is nothing suspicious about this matter. Xiao Cen chose to sacrifice himself to save the captain who made a mistake in judgment from the aberrations when he was fully autonomous."

"Ouch..." Qin Su groaned in confusion, "Is it worth it? Is there anything more important than your own life?"

"Perhaps, loyalty, courage, and belief." Mia said, "She is a great guide who deserves to be respected and remembered by everyone."

Qin Su complained, "Fortunately you didn't say it's worth learning for everyone."

Mia paused, "The White Tower never advocates unnecessary sacrifices."

"It's not necessary?" Qin Su immediately grasped the key point, "This is not necessary. How do you describe Xiao Cen's sacrifice?"

Mia's light flaxen eyes turned to look at Qin Su, "You are trying to trick me."

"I just want to trick you. Please tell me more. I'm really made bald by them." Xiao Cen clasped his hands to Mia, "Please, please~"

Another cute behavior rarely seen by sentries and guides.

Mia smiled helplessly and shook her head, "Okay, then I'll tell you what I can."

Unnecessary sacrifice refers to Uriah's somewhat lonely and radical impulsive fighting characteristics in the contaminated area.

And Xiao Cen, as a guide, is only C-level, but considering the rarity of guides, especially healing guides, and including her future potential, her value is no lower than A+ Uriah.

Xiao Cen should protect himself first.

"You sound so official, I protest!" Qin Su frowned with disgust.

Mia still smiled and seemed to be able to understand and tolerate all the voices that she didn't understand. "If you encounter a similar situation, please protect yourself first and promise me, okay?"

This sentence is not official anymore.

Qin Su grunted again, "I'm very scared to death, and I don't have that high consciousness of sacrificing for others. Besides, I don't understand anything now. I can't be qualified to go on a mission in a contaminated area in just a short while, right?"

Mia did not deny it, "Captain Lisong will take these things into consideration for you. He has not given orders to fight with the team, so you don't need to go with them."

"Then, then that!" Qin Su wanted to struggle again, "Can't you really tell me more?"

"Okay~ If it's convenient, can you allow me to check your guide element?"

What is this?Just interrupt me!

Qin Su knew that it was impossible for Mia to tell her more.

With a grimace, he spread his hands and said, "I don't know how to release the wizard."

"Huh?" Mia was a little surprised, "I thought Teacher Wei had already taught you."

"He..." Qin Su's face suddenly became hot. "He knows how to poke my lower back and suck me hard. Now I only know that external stimulation of the glands can release the guide element, but do I have to beat myself up every time when I release it? You are also a guide, can you teach me a more decent method?"
